method: Built-in Image Gen using the approved logo reference
darkAdaptation: Amber upper B, white lower B and wordmark; negative-space plus apertures show background.
deliverableType: PNG presentation boards and original selected PNG. UI screens are illustrative placement previews. No standalone transparent or vector asset exports are included.

items.prompt: Use case: logo-brand presentation and precise-object-edit. Create a clean professional LOGO VARIATIONS BOARD for the EXACT APPROVED Barber++ logo in the attached image. This is one approved identity shown in usage variants, NOT new concept exploration. Target canvas 2048 x 2560 portrait. ABSOLUTELY FLAT SOLID COLORS: NO glow, NO shadows, NO metallic gold, NO texture, NO gradients, NO 3D. Main colors exact amber #D4A853, charcoal #151A20 and white. CRITICAL LOGO INVARIANTS: capital B consists of TWO stacked aligned letter halves separated by a fine HORIZONTAL gap. The ENTIRE upper half is amber, ENTIRE lower half charcoal in normal mode. ONE WHITE PLUS-SHAPED CUTOUT centered in each half, equal sizes, perfectly vertically aligned. The B has flat left edge, two rounded right bowls. Preserve reference proportions, plus shapes, baseline and letterform faithfully. NO folded corner, no diagonal split, no outside enclosing badge. Exact wordmark Barber++ in Outfit-like bold geometric sans, normal charcoal Barber and amber ++. BOARD: 2 columns and 5 clearly separated rows, generous margins and crisp small captions. Header 'Barber++' and small subtitle 'Logo system'. Column headings 'LIGHT' on left and 'DARK' on right. The entire left column has white background; right column has solid charcoal #151A20 background. Row captions: 'Horizontal', 'Stacked', 'Symbol', 'Wordmark', 'Monochrome'. Row 1 shows a horizontal symbol-left wordmark-right lockup in each theme. Row 2 shows the approved stacked symbol-over-wordmark arrangement in each theme. Row 3 shows standalone B monogram, no rounded app tile. Row 4 shows the wordmark only. Row 5 shows the B symbol and small wordmark in ONE INK only: all-charcoal on left and all-white on right. DARK COLOR VARIANT: upper half remains amber; lower half becomes WHITE. Both plus apertures remain NEGATIVE SPACE showing the charcoal background. Dark wordmark uses WHITE Barber and amber ++. The waist separator also shows background. Never make the two plus holes white in a white lower B. All duplicates of the symbol must have IDENTICAL geometry and aspect ratio; recolor only for themes. Logos comfortably fit each cell with proportional scale, careful aligned baselines. Board is editorial, restrained and readable, thin light gray row rules on white and subtle gray on dark. Tiny footer 'Amber #D4A853  /  Charcoal #151A20'. No UI mockups, browser chrome, device bezel, decorative element or extra slogan. One complete board, all variants legible and consistent.

Use case: ui-mockup and logo-brand presentation. Create ONE polished DESKTOP LOGO-USAGE COMPARISON BOARD for the approved Barber++ identity. Target canvas 3072 x 1536 landscape. Use the two attached references: first is the EXACT APPROVED logo geometry; second is the approved light/dark logo system. Preserve that identity exactly, do not redesign it. The logo symbol is an uppercase B made of two stacked aligned blocks separated by a thin horizontal gap, one equal plus-shaped negative aperture in each block. Upper block amber #D4A853; lower charcoal #151A20 on white and WHITE on dark. Dark mode apertures show the dark background. Exact wordmark Barber++, charcoal or white Barber depending on theme, amber ++. No folded corner, no diagonal cap or other monogram. BOARD LAYOUT: small editorial heading 'Barber++ / Desktop' above two large equal desktop app SCREEN CAPTURES side by side, labels 'Light' and 'Dark'. Each screen is 1440 x 900 natural desktop aspect ratio, no stretching, same app state and content. Outer board pale neutral #F0F2F5 with generous gutters and no device bodies. Screen captures are rectangular app content only, no browser bar. PRODUCT: calm bookings management workspace for shop owners, not a generic marketing page. Light side white base, subtle #F7F8FA sidebar, dark charcoal text; dark side #151A20 main base, #20262D sidebar, off-white text. Shared AMBER primary action with dark text. Fonts Outfit-inspired, restrained responsive product sizes, clear hierarchy. Place the horizontal approved logo at the top of each sidebar, about 190px wide and 40px high, symbol left of wordmark. Make it cleanly readable at realistic UI scale. Sidebar items 'Overview', 'Bookings' selected, 'Team', 'Services', 'Shops', 'Settings', with small consistent simple outline icons. Main top bar 'Bookings', right quiet avatar with initials 'MA'. Main heading 'Today’s bookings', small subtitle 'Saturday, 31 October', amber button 'Create booking'. Below simple filters 'All barbers' and 'All services', then ONE clean booking table with four rows and columns Time, Customer, Service, Barber, Status. Sample rows 10:00 Omar Haircut Ali Confirmed; 10:30 Fahad Beard trim Yousef Confirmed; 11:00 Salem Haircut Ali Pending; 11:30 Ahmad Haircut and beard Yousef Confirmed. Readable concise copy, thin row dividers, no nested cards, no invented charts or decorative metrics. Leave ample whitespace around the table. Both themes same geometry and state. Logos and typography are the visual priority, UI is context to demonstrate practical desktop size. No full-screen giant watermark, no arbitrary new logo, no oversized app icon in sidebar. Flat presentation, no 3D, no shadows, no metallic gold, no glow, no phone or laptop mockup. Small footer 'Logo placement preview' to make clear these are illustrative interface presentations.

Use case: ui-mockup and logo-brand presentation. Create ONE polished MOBILE LOGO-USAGE BOARD comparing LIGHT and DARK themes for the exact approved Barber++ identity. Target 1536 x 1152 landscape board, two portrait app-content frames side by side, each natural 390 x 844 ratio, large enough to read. Header 'Barber++ / Mobile' above frames; small labels 'Light' and 'Dark'. Outer board background pale neutral #F0F2F5. No phone hardware, no device bezel, no rounded phone mask, no browser chrome, no OS status bar, no clock/signal/battery, no device shadows. This is a pair of clean MOBILE WEB BOOKING PAGE SCREENSHOTS, not a coded or live app. Use attached reference 1 as the approved logo geometry and reference 2 as the light/dark logo system. Logo MUST be the B made from two aligned full half-letter blocks with horizontal waist separator, upper half amber, lower half charcoal in light theme and WHITE in dark theme. Exactly one PLUS-SHAPED NEGATIVE APERTURE centered in each half, identical size and aligned. Dark plus holes show dark background. No fold, corner cap, diagonal split or different icon. Wordmark exact 'Barber++', charcoal/white Barber depending on theme, amber ++. Each mobile page starts with a slim header carrying a COMPACT HORIZONTAL LOGO, B icon left and readable wordmark right, total logo width about 165px and symbol height about 32px. Right side quiet language button 'EN'. Main content is customer booking for a sample shop called 'Studio 01'. Clear heading 'Book your next visit'. Section 'Choose a service' with simple full-width grouped rows: Haircut / 30 min selected with amber indicator; Beard trim / 20 min; Haircut and beard / 45 min. No made-up shop photos or oversized logos in page body. Section 'Choose a barber', one clean select labelled 'Any available barber'. Section 'Available times' with a two-row grid of 6 buttons 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30; 10:30 selected amber with dark text. Bottom simple summary 'Haircut · 30 min' and ONE amber full-width button 'Continue'. No WhatsApp, no chat button, no social media icons, no prices needed. Same geometry and content for light and dark screens. Light: white main surface, charcoal text, gray thin dividers. Dark: solid #151A20 main surface, #22292F field surfaces, off-white text, restrained gray dividers. Outfit-like text at realistic 16px base and 30px heading, generous clean spacing, clear touch-sized rows/buttons, single grouped service list without nested cards. Amber #D4A853 shared action accent with dark labels. Logo placement is main purpose; reproduce approved logo faithfully at real compact-header scale. Flat restrained presentation, no glow, no gold texture, no gradients, no 3D. Small caption at board bottom 'Customer booking page · Logo placement preview'.

Use case: logo-brand usage presentation. Create ONE clean APP ICON AND FAVICON PRESENTATION BOARD for the EXACT APPROVED Barber++ logo. 2048 x 1536 landscape, pale neutral #F0F2F5 canvas, restrained editorial layout. References: first approved logo; second approved light/dark logo system. Preserve the capital B geometry exactly: two aligned stacked half-letter blocks separated by thin horizontal gap; upper entire half amber #D4A853; lower entire half charcoal #151A20 in normal mode. One identically shaped PLUS-SHAPED NEGATIVE APERTURE per half, two plus holes vertically aligned; no diagonal fold, corner cap or redesigned B. In reversed dark version, upper remains amber and LOWER HALF WHITE; negative plus holes and gap show background. Heading 'Barber++ / Compact use'. Main upper area has TWO LARGE same-sized simple flat rounded-square app icon tiles, labels 'Light app icon' and 'Dark app icon'. Left tile pure white containing centered normal B with generous safe padding, right tile charcoal containing centered amber-and-white B with same safe padding. Use subtle thin tile outlines only, no shadows, gloss, texture, metallic color, gradients or 3D. Do NOT draw a phone or OS home screen. Beneath a clean divider, section label 'Favicon & compact navigation'. Show two SIMPLE DESKTOP BROWSER TAB STRIPS side by side, one white/light and one dark charcoal. A small version of the same B icon sits at left of each active tab beside text 'Barber++ | Bookings'. Keep favicons simple and visually plausible at small scale, no brand-shape changes. Below those strips show two compact HEADER BRAND LOCKUPS, dark text on white and white text on dark, using B icon plus the exact wordmark Barber++ with amber ++, as in the approved system. Each lockup has generous whitespace and illustrates a compact sidebar/header use. Keep all text short and clean. Footer 'Symbol-only use for small spaces'. This is one identity with practical application variants, not alternative concepts. All B symbols must retain the same proportion and cutouts. No new logo, mockup device, extra emoji, decoration or irrelevant interface. Logos are priority, flat editorial design with excellent alignment.
